defs.StorytellerDef/HH_Hetty.label: Hetty Hearthwell
defs.StorytellerDef/HH_Hetty.description: Hetty runs the friendliest waystation on the rim and wants yours to thrive. Raids come rarely and gently, bad luck stays mild and good fortune knocks often: traders, travellers, wanderers who want to stay, and plenty of guests.\n\nFor players who want to build. On the higher difficulties she still pushes back, just kindly. Anomaly threats follow the Anomaly settings as usual, while its eerie side events come more rarely. Animals never fall ill under her care.
